assertions: Invoke NetworkWeb.search for each case; capture the actual request q and actual raw response body through an HTTPX transport wrapper.
Actual q must contain the original query verbatim followed by each required term enclosed by ordinary double quote delimiters; delimiters are not backslash-prefixed.

A deterministic positive MockTransport regression returns a result only when provider q includes all required terms; NetworkWeb must keep it when returned title/snippet satisfy the unchanged ALL-term parser filter.
No expected result counts or relevance are asserted for live RSS captures.
